purpose: Bounded 9B development candidate after smaller-model source-review failures. Resource fit, runtime compatibility and analytic quality remain unqualified; installation and upstream benchmarks do not establish project acceptance.

model.license_evidence: Qwen original model card and pinned Unsloth quantization metadata identify Apache-2.0. Quantization is published by Unsloth, not Qwen.

installation.supported_installer_platform: Windows ARM64 only. Unsupported operating systems or architectures are rejected before downloads or cache writes. The read-only plan remains available on any platform.
installation.scope: Dedicated user cache outside repository; no administrator privileges, global PATH edits, or credentials.
installation.verification: Exact size and SHA256 checked before archive extraction or model use.
installation.network: Pinned GitHub llama.cpp and Unsloth Hugging Face assets; services may redirect to asset CDNs. Local inference only.
installation.resources: Model plus projector files total 5591809824 bytes; this is a disk/download quantity, not a memory requirement. Resource fit requires a separately measured controlled load before a full investigation. Disk must also accommodate the runtime archive, extraction and existing caches.
installation.cost: No paid service or subscription required; local compute, disk, electricity, and download bandwidth remain resource requirements.
